{{< include latex-macros/macros.qmd >}}

A [Huffman code](huffman-codes.qmd#def-huffman-code) gives each value a whole number of [bits](entropy.qmd#def-bit),
so its [expected length](source-coding.qmd#def-expected-length) can exceed the [entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy) by nearly one bit per value.
This page shows how to code a whole message at once,
so that the waste is shared among all of its values.
